summary: Inspected 50+ files from the OSSS directory covering statistical mechanics formalization. All files contain formal mathematical definitions, lemmas, theorems, and proofs related to OSSS inequality, FK models, adaptive causal kernels, coding theory, revealment bounds, Poincaré inequalities, wired box criticality, and related topics.
